params.prompt: Create a 9:16 iPhone 15 front-facing camera UGC storyboard grid for Scene 1 of "CALM C12 Bathroom Test" - 3x3 layout, exactly 9 panels on a clean black canvas, panels separated by thin black gutters only. Overarching scene theme: A real founder films herself in a small bathroom mirror with harsh overhead light, damp hair, bare skin, mirror smudges, and slight handheld shake. The scene progresses from visibly irritated cheek redness to applying a serum bottle labeled exactly "CALM C12" to a believable calmer finish. Keep the aesthetic raw, phone-shot, imperfect, and not commercial-polished. The product bottle must remain readable whenever it appears. Panels left-to-right top-to-bottom: Panel 1 founder leans close to mirror showing red cheek patches. Panel 2 fingertip points to the worst patch. Panel 3 she lifts the CALM C12 bottle beside her face, label readable. Panel 4 dropper hovers over cheek. Panel 5 serum is rubbed across both cheeks. Panel 6 phone reflection shows the bottle on sink beside messy toiletries. Panel 7 same mirror angle, cheeks look calmer but still natural. Panel 8 founder compares cheek texture in close-up. Panel 9 she holds CALM C12 at chest height, label facing camera. Environment: small bathroom mirror, midday, clear. Mood: hopeful. Visual style: raw UGC photorealism, real skin texture, slight motion blur, authentic iPhone color science. Camera/lens feel: shot on iPhone 15, iPhone built-in, natural. Below each panel: a narrow black caption band with panel number, time code, and two plain-English visual captions. Forbidden: no title banner, no footer, no colored gridlines, no director notes, no SFX, no BGM, no voiceover text. Render at 9:16 aspect ratio, 1K, medium quality.
